svg.title: As-built feather templates - 42 feathers, 1:1 mm, vertical flip
svg.desc: As-built feather catalog, one group per feather prefix. Each outline is copied verbatim from its individual file and only translated and mirrored (vertical) about its own centre, so it stays 1:1 (user units = mm) and keeps its label. Every feather's geometry lives once in <defs> as a definition (id + "-def", with data-wh/data-vb recording the frame it was drawn in); the <use> that places it carries only the rotation the arrangement needs. This file is self-contained -- there are no individuals/*.svg any more.
